 Experience Yoga on the Calm Waters of Door County, Wisconsin
This is a beginner-friendly class designed to allow you to be challenged while enjoying a relaxing time on the water, no matter your level of experience. This class starts with a lesson on land to warm up the body and teach you the paddle technique. Then, we paddle to a calm area on the water and anchor the boards before moving through a yoga asana followed by a blissful water savasana. Yoga is led by Jacqueline Soukup, RYT 200, of Sun Yoga Bum.

Whether you’re a yoga newbie or were the valedictorian of your yoga teacher training, this class is suitable for you. Bring water and sunscreen, and prepare to relax. Do a yoga class before a kayak tour to get your muscles stretched and ready to paddle by the time you reach your kayak.

What’s SUP?
Stand-up paddle boarding (SUP) is one of the newest and fastest-growing water sports in the world! You can easily learn it with our knowledgeable instructors and beginner boards. The beginner stand-up paddle boards we use are stable and enjoyable for all ages.

No skills are necessary to have fun.

Paddle boarding provides an excellent workout and challenges your balance.

We give you basic paddling instruction and tips on standing up.

The lake warms up very quickly in Door County and makes for a fun spot to learn to paddle board.

If you want to rent a paddle board for a full day or longer, we can drop it off so it’s waiting for you when you arrive in Door County.
